mapper.select: SELECT switch_key, enabled, reason, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_trading_risk_switch ORDER BY switch_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_trading_risk_switch (switch_key, enabled, reason, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{switchKey}, #{enabled}, #{reason}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), reason = VALUES(reason), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
